pins.says: No UD documentation page declares these as clitics. Forms are attested as PART in the treebank (16,413 PART tokens, 45 distinct forms). The treebank is a giver of CANDIDATES, not of given forms (tokenizer-rule-def: a corpus alone is a candidate, never 'given'). The sandhi codec (sanskrit-sandhi.js) is the more relevant tool for Sanskrit's actual fusion problem.
